page.overview:
Who is Dai?

Upon speaking to , he will be spooked by 's presence and consequently chide him for scaring him. Afterwards, will explain that he is attempting to slay the monsters inside the for the treasure and they guard. If speaks to him a second time, will boast about his skills in battle or suggest that scouts out the area first. However, will not actually go into the . At midnight, will fall asleep against the wall that he hides behind, dreaming of defeating the monsters inside the . will wake up and resume his activities at 05:00 AM.

If defeats the inside the and returns to , he will give a , valued at 100 , for his trouble. does not gift the reward if the has become a or .}} He will then tell that he can handle the situation on his own and bids him farewell.
